findings.issue: Wrong subject: 僕は means 'I' (masculine casual), and pt correctly says 'Olhei', but en says 'He looked'. Sense-changing person error, inconsistent with lit_en ('As for me') and expl.
findings.current: He looked at the sea through the curtains.
findings.suggested: I looked at the sea through the curtain.

findings.issue: １８００人 (population + counter 人) must be read せんはっぴゃくにん; digit-by-digit いちはちれいれい is a code/phone-number reading style, wrong for a quantity with a counter.
findings.current: かりにじんこうがいちはちれいれいにんとします
findings.suggested: かりにじんこうがせんはっぴゃくにんとします

findings.issue: Reading of numeral １８００ before counter 人 is the digit-by-digit style; the correct in-context reading is せんはっぴゃく.
Tense error: 有りませんでした is polite negative PAST (as lit_en, pt and both expl fields state), but en is present tense with an added 'any more' nuance not in the JP.
findings.current: There aren't very many chances any more.
findings.suggested: The opportunity never really came up.

findings.issue: Literal mirror is inaccurate: it drops the main verb 見た ('saw') entirely and invents a 'you know' sentence-final nuance although the JP has no ね/よ. lit_pt renders it correctly ('viu').
findings.current: As for him, that was for the first time, you know.
findings.suggested: As for him (が, subject), for the first time, that (を) he saw.

findings.issue: Stray leftover tokens: tokens[0] あり and tokens[1] 方 (all fields null) sit before 一人一人, out of sentence order, duplicating the properly glossed あり方 token later in the list. Breaks token-to-surface alignment.
findings.current: tokens[0]={"s":"あり", all null}, tokens[1]={"s":"方", all null}
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1]; あり方 is already tokenized and glossed at its correct position.

findings.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong digit-by-digit kana reading of １８００人; should follow せんはっぴゃくにん.
Garbled rendering: adds a causal 'então' absent from the JP, leaves 'não via' without object, and mixes tenses (faz + assisti). 久しぶりに just means the action happened after a long interval.
findings.current: Faz tempo que eu não via, então assisti a um filme antigo.
findings.suggested: Depois de muito tempo, assisti a um filme antigo.

findings.issue: 久しぶりに modifies the act of watching ('after a long while I watched...'); the relative clause 'I hadn't seen in a long time' misattaches it to the movie and presupposes prior viewing of that specific film.
findings.current: I watched an old movie I hadn't seen in a long time.
findings.suggested: I watched an old movie for the first time in a while.

findings.issue: 'Quanto a eu' is ungrammatical Portuguese: preposition 'a' requires the oblique pronoun ('quanto a mim'). The corpus itself uses 'Quanto a mim' correctly elsewhere (e.g. jec-0231).
findings.current: Quanto a eu, fixamente a paisagem de fora olho.
findings.suggested: Quanto a mim, fixamente a paisagem de fora olho.

findings.issue: Drops the 'at least one' nuance of 一つは, which is the pedagogical point of the sentence; pt ('pelo menos uma'), lit_en and both expl fields all include it, so en is inconsistent with the lesson.
findings.current: Nearly every island has one like that.
findings.suggested: Nearly every island has at least one thing like this.
